tasks.finalMessage: All verified problems are fixed. `projects/survey-form/` now contains all four files: - **Verifier patterns — all pass**: `<form>` (1), labels (14), required controls (11), `type="email"`, rating radio group (5 options), `<select>`, checkbox group (4 features + consent), success-state markup, `preventDefault()` in app.js, validation handling via `checkValidity()`/`ValidityState`, and `@media` responsive layout. - **Form contents**: labeled name/email, required rating radios in a fieldset, usage select, feature checkboxes, textarea, required consent, submit button with privacy note. - **Validation paths inspected end-to-end**: empty/short name, empty/malformed email, no rating (shared error wired via `data-error-id` — this was a real bug I found and fixed), unselected option, unchecked consent, live re-validation as fields are fixed, focus moved to first invalid control, success panel revealed with summary after a valid submit, and full reset via "Submit another response". - **Checks run**: HTML parses clean (no tag errors, one real `id="rating-error"` — the duplicate flag was a false positive matching `data-error-id`), label/aria-describedby targets resolve, CSS braces balanced with no undefined variables, `node --check` passes, zero network references, and `git status` confirms only `projects/survey-form/` was added.
